caption:
“I want to be honest with you. Your work has been missing the mark.” feels softer than silence, but it still leaves them guessing.

Kind is not vague. If you want change, name the work, the gap, and what good looks like next time.

What feedback line do you catch yourself softening too much?

#newmanager #leadership #management

slides.label: Stop saying
slides.quote: “I want to be honest with you. Your work has been missing the mark.”

slides.headline: It sounds serious, but says <u>nothing</u>.
slides.sub: They hear concern, not what to change on Monday.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “The risks section was missing. Next time, include it on the last slide.”

slides.headline: Be kind and <u>specific</u>.
slides.sub: Say what was missing and what you need next time.

slides.headline: Knowing what to say is the easy part.
slides.sub: Practice saying it with Steady before the real talk.

first_comment: Steady is an app for saying the hard thing out loud before the real conversation: https://steadyyy.com
